arguments.summary: Fixed issue #58 by replacing the single-unit-only logic in units/duration.py with the maintainer's regex-based implementation: parse_duration now validates the input with re.fullmatch(r"(\d+[hms])+") and sums all (number, unit) tokens via re.findall, so compound durations like "1h30m" (5400), "2m5s"...
